# Test fixtures

Small, curated, committed inputs. Large recordings belong in `recordings/` (git-ignored).

- `measurement_bearing_only_v1.hex`: golden wire frame (v1), derived by hand from
  the format spec, not produced by either encoder. Both the C++ and Python tests
  must reproduce it exactly. If it has to change, the wire version changes too.
- `scenarios/<name>/`: ground-truth regression scenarios generated by the simulator
  (`sim/sifted_sim/scenarios.py`), used by `tests/scenario_regression_test.cpp`:
  - `sensors.cfg`: sensor table (ADR 0003)
  - `frames.hex`: one wire-v1 frame per line, hex, in send order
  - `truth.csv`: `time_ns,x_m,y_m,vx_mps,vy_mps`, one row per frame

  Regenerate after changing a scenario or the simulator, then re-check the RMSE
  baselines in the regression test header:

  ```bash
  cd sim && python3 -m sifted_sim.generate straight_crossing ../tests/fixtures/scenarios/straight_crossing
  cd sim && python3 -m sifted_sim.generate turn ../tests/fixtures/scenarios/turn
  ```
